rows.label: Show buff button
rows.tooltip: Shows one button out of combat with the next buff you should cast and on whom. Each click casts it. Druids share Mark of the Wild and Thorns, paladins split blessings so each target gets the most cover, and Salvation is never assigned. Bind it under Key Bindings, Steward: Buff Manager.

rows.label: Alert when buffs are due
rows.tooltip: Plays a sound and shows the buffs owed in the raid warning area when you go from nothing to cast to something to cast, out of combat, at most once a minute.

rows.label: Alert sound
rows.tooltip: The sound the alert plays: a quiet map ping by default, two other Blizzard sounds, or any sound registered with LibSharedMedia by your addons. Picking one plays it.

rows.label: Buff macro
rows.tooltip: Keeps a character macro named HoobiBuffs that clicks the buff button, with the icon of the buff it will cast next. Put it on an action bar to bind it like a spell.

rows.label: Missing buffs on raid frames
rows.tooltip: Shows a small icon on Blizzard's party and raid frames for each buff your party could give that member but it lacks. Blizzard's own buff icons only show the buffs you cast yourself.

rows.label: Only show buffs I can cast
rows.tooltip: Leaves out of the raid frame icons every buff you do not know yourself, so a druid sees only missing Mark of the Wild and Thorns.

rows.label: Blessing of Kings
rows.tooltip: With fewer seconds left than this, Blessing of Kings counts as missing and the button offers to recast it, out of combat only. 0 to 3600, default 120.
